lessons.title: Criteria for Living Things
lessons.objective: Define the criteria that determine if something is living: grow, energy, respond, and reproduce.
must_establish: The four criteria that define living things are grow, energy, respond, and reproduce.

lessons.title: Applying Criteria to Classify
lessons.objective: Classify given examples as living or nonliving by evaluating them against all four criteria.
must_establish: To classify something as living, it must meet all four criteria.
A rock is classified as nonliving because it does not grow, use energy, respond, or reproduce.
A tree is classified as living because it grows, uses energy, responds, and reproduces.
A toy robot is classified as nonliving because it does not grow, use energy, respond, or reproduce.
A fish is classified as living because it grows, uses energy, responds, and reproduces.
